name: HalluQA
intro: HalluQA是针对中文大型语言模型幻觉现象的问答基准。它包含450个跨越多个领域的精心设计的对抗性问题，特别考虑了中国的历史文化、风俗习惯和社会现象。该基准在构建过程中区分了模仿性虚假和事实性错误两种幻觉类型，并基于GLM-130B和ChatGPT构建了对抗性样本。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, LLM生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证, 选择题
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Fact Verification, Multiple Choice
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation
intro_en: HalluQA is a question-answering benchmark targeting hallucination phenomena in Chinese large language models. It contains 450 carefully designed adversarial questions across multiple domains, with special consideration of Chinese history, culture, customs, and social phenomena. The benchmark distinguishes between imitative falsehoods and factual errors as two types of hallucinations and constructs adversarial samples based on GLM-130B and ChatGPT.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.03368. HalluQA targets Chinese LLM hallucinations through two data parts: misleading questions for imitative falsehoods and knowledge questions for factual errors. Misleading questions are adapted from TruthfulQA-style patterns and Chinese cultural contexts, probed with GLM-130B five times, and kept when the model produces imitative falsehoods at least three of five times; harder misleading questions are also created with ChatGPT. Knowledge questions are written by ten Chinese graduate interns, probed with ChatGPT and Puyu, then filtered by an NLP expert. Each item receives correct/wrong answers and external support links, low-quality annotations are removed, and GPT-4 judges model answers by majority vote for non-hallucination rate.
